The House Committee on Regulated Industries offers Bill 1254 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Reeves of the following substitute to HB 1254: 99th, Hatchett of the 155th, Wade of the 9th, Prince of the 132nd, Seabaugh of the 34th, and others
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend various titles of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, so as to move the regulation of various professions from individual boards to the Secretary of State; to amend Chapter … enforce this article and all rules 1494 and regulations adopted by the board pursuant to this article."
1495 PART VI 1496 SECTION 6-1.
1497 All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
